forward_eligibility_constraint: Measured and reproducible, and the first candidate to pass the pre-declared concurrency-scaling threshold (2.15 against 1.25). Not consumed by Forward: the compound criterion also required the latency times a source-derived round count per task to land within a factor of two of the 13.0 us scalar floor at sixteen groups, and it does not. The PFA source places its QK_READY, SOFTMAX_READY and UPDATE_READY crossings inside the per-KV-block loop, about three crossings per block, giving roughly three to four and a half round trips per task at KV 512, hence 2.7 to 4.1 us against 13.0 us. Wiring it would also need a rigorous source-derived round count, and its per-KV-block scaling would add time to the already over-predicted long-KV tail.

measurement.timing_boundary: in-kernel GetSystemCycle around the AIC handoff loop, max over AIC cores per launch, median over fresh processes; identical to the control-floor cells and never mixed with aclrtEvent or msprof spans

publication_scope.concurrency_scaling_note: The pre-declared threshold was 1.25. Computed on stable cells only, h(24)/h(16) = 1.599 and the threshold is passed. The wider h(24)/h(8) = 2.154 is not used because its denominator failed the stability gate.
publication_scope.round_trip: AIC issues CrossCoreSetFlag<2, PIPE_FIX> then CrossCoreWaitFlag; AIV mirrors with CrossCoreWaitFlag then CrossCoreSetFlag<2, PIPE_MTE3>; sync mode 2 is the source's own FIA_SYNC_MODE2. No DataCopy, Mmad, Fixpipe, Vector arithmetic or memory traffic.
publication_scope.stability_note: Process-median spread at handoffs=128 is 28.06% at one group and 11.96% at eight, both failing the campaign's 5% stability gate; 1.18%, 1.53% and 2.37% at sixteen, twenty-two and twenty-four. Only the three stable cells are published as service values.
